lines: Our holiday kits are made for complete carving beginners.

Comment CARVE and we'll share this week's Black Friday kits.

why: Серія «Black Friday: перший набір», формула «один набір у кадрі» з відео наборів на 1,5 млн переглядів. Мета: заявки покупців подарунків, умови акції — після підтвердження клієнта.
rules: Show BeaverCraft products (kits, knives, finished figures) in the first seconds. Wood carving only — no other crafts (no straw, weaving, painting), no stone or marble sculpture, no clay. Prefer BeaverCraft's own carving footage (hands carving wood, kits being opened, finished figures) over stock; no random stock people who are not carving wood. No text over faces.

problems: Frames at 9.8s and 11.6s are near-identical to the 0.9s hook frame, so the video feels static and repetitive
Frames at 6.3s and 8.0s are the same kit box shot, repeated with only a slight change
No hands carving or kit being opened by a family, so the 'open it together and carve the same evening' line is shown only by static still-life
Basswood blank, knife and lesson are not clearly shown inside the box; the 'each box has' line is only loosely matched
Hook text box sits close to the figures and the first frame shows no kit, only loose figures and knives
qa.fix: Replace the repeated static stills with real footage of hands opening the kit, showing the basswood blank, knife and lesson, then carving, and end on a bold Black Friday kit shot with a large CARVE CTA.
